camel_example: aliyun oceanbasepro DescribeProjectStepMetric --region cn-hangzhou --MetricType RPS --ProjectId np_dr0000 --Aggregator AVG --StepName FULL_TRANSFER --EndTimestamp 1689254646 --BeginTimestamp 1689244696
description_en: This API retrieves step-level metrics for a data migration or data synchronization task
description_zh: 本接口用于查询数据迁移或数据同步任务的运行步骤的指标
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro describe-project-step-metric --project-id np_dr0000 --step-name FULL_TRANSFER --metric-type RPS --aggregator AVG --begin-timestamp 1689244696 --end-timestamp 1689254646 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeProjectStepMetric

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data migration or data synchronization project
parameters.help_zh: 数据迁移或数据同步任务的 ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the task step. You can specify one of the following values: `FULL_TRANSFER` for full transfer, `INCR_TRANSFER` for incremental transfer, `FULL_VERIFIER` for full verification, and `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER` for reverse incremental transfer
parameters.help_zh: 任务运行步骤的名称，包括 `FULL_TRANSFER`、`INCR_TRANSFER`、`FULL_VERIFIER` 和 `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER`
parameters.name: step_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the metric to query for the task step. The available options depend on the value of `StepName`.

For the `FULL_TRANSFER` step, valid metrics are RPS, IOPS, SOURCE_READ_TIME, SOURCE_SLICE_TIME, and SINK_EXECUTE_TIME.

For the `INCR_TRANSFER` step, valid metrics are DELAY, IOPS, RPS, SINK_COMMIT_TIME, and SINK_EXECUTE_TIME.

For the `FULL_VERIFIER` step, valid metrics are FULL_VERIFY_SOURCE_RPS, FULL_VERIFY_SOURCE_READ_IOPS, FULL_VERIFY_DEST_RPS, and FULL_VERIFY_DEST_READ_IOPS.

For the `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER` step, valid metrics are RPS, IOPS, DELAY, SINK_EXECUTE_TIME, and SINK_COMMIT_TIME
parameters.help_zh:
任务运行步骤对应的指标。
  • `FULL_TRANSFER` 对应的指标包括 RPS、IOPS、SOURCE_READ_TIME、SOURCE_SLICE_TIME 和 SINK_EXECUTE_TIME。
  • `INCR_TRANSFER` 对应的指标包括 DELAY、IOPS、RPS、SINK_COMMIT_TIME 和 SINK_EXECUTE_TIME。
  • `FULL_VERIFIER` 对应的指标包括 FULL_VERIFY_SOURCE_RPS、FULL_VERIFY_SOURCE_READ_IOPS、FULL_VERIFY_DEST_RPS 和 FULL_VERIFY_DEST_READ_IOPS。
  • `REVERSE_INCR_TRANSFER` 对应的指标包括 RPS、IOPS、DELAY、SINK_EXECUTE_TIME 和 SINK_COMMIT_TIME。
parameters.name: metric_type

parameters.help_en: The aggregation method for the metric data. Specify `AVG` to return the average value or `NONE` to return the instantaneous value. The default is `NONE`
parameters.help_zh: 聚合算子，包括 `AVG`（平均数据折线图）和 `NONE`（瞬时数据折线图）。默认值为 `NONE`
parameters.name: aggregator

parameters.help_en: The start of the query time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The total time range must be at least one hour
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间，单位为秒级时间戳。开始时间和结束时间的间隔不低于 1 小时
parameters.name: begin_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The end of the query time range, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. This value cannot be in the future
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间，单位为秒级时间戳。结束时间不能晚于当前时间
parameters.name: end_timestamp

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of data points to return. The value must be between 5 and 7**24\60. For optimal results, the value should meet the following condition: (time range in minutes) / MaxPointNum > 5
parameters.help_zh: 最大查询点数。取值范围： 5~72460，建议值：时间段（单位分钟）/maxPointNum > 5
parameters.name: max_point_num
